issues.title: Add the search-results endpoint
issues.spec: Implement GET /search that takes a query string, runs it against the search index, and returns ranked results as JSON. Implementation note: this endpoint is blocked by the search-index ingestion job — it needs the inverted-index builder to have run and populated the index store first; that ingestion pipeline does not exist yet and has no ticket. Once the index is populated, wiring the query path here is straightforward: tokenise the query, look up postings, rank by BM25, and serialise.

question: Does ISS-CG's implementation advice reference any work that no ticket tracks (a chain gap)? If so, list each as { reference, sub_type } where sub_type is upstream/downstream/peer/sub-ticket; if there is no real gap after conservative skips, return an empty list.
